_comment: 'Once per Turn Instant - {r}{r}' is card-level activation_cost=2 + per_turn=1 (DSL-authoritative; not re-modelled as a PAY_RESOURCES cost). 'Activate this only if you've played a Lightning card this turn' is an ability-level EVENT_THIS_TURN gate on event=play qualifier=Lightning: play.py records one marker per talent on every hand play (_apply_play_card -> _record_turn_event), and _add_hero_dsl_activations checks ability conditions BEFORE offering the activation, so the ability is not even offered on a turn without a Lightning play - which matches 'Activate this only if'. CREATE_TOKEN reads token/amount/player/destination (handler confirmed); token definition already exists at json/tokens/embodiment_of_lightning.json, so no destination param is needed - zone routing derives from the template subtypes. 'Essence of Lightning' is in printed_keywords: it comes from the card DB and is deliberately NOT authored here.
